name: pintag-homepage-i18n-tests
description: Regression coverage for index.html's language switching. Added after the hero panel labels (.panel-label, 'Buyer/Renter' and 'Seller/Landlord') were found to be single hardcoded Lao strings with no en-i/zh-i counterpart at all -- unlike every other string on the page, switching to English or Chinese never changed them. Also covers a second bug found in the same audit: Card 2's Lao sublabel literally contained the untranslated English word 'Agent'.
